clips.title: The story
paras: At Menethil Harbor, Captain Stoutfist fears a Dragonmaw siege. Chieftain Nek'rosh has built engines to bombard the vulnerable port town, while fighting at Dun Algaz cuts off reinforcements. You are sent into the marshes to destroy the catapults before the attack begins.

Dwarven scouts uncovered Nek'rosh's plan as Alliance fighters clashed with Dragonmaw raiders. The chieftain has overseen the building of full-scale siege catapults in the Wetlands encampments. He means to bring the engines to Menethil Harbor and batter its fortress walls, threatening the Alliance's main shipping hub on the western coast.

Fighting and greenskin activity have congested the mountain passes at Dun Algaz, isolating the lowlands from Ironforge's main garrisons. Without aid from Khaz Modan, Captain Stoutfist cannot spare troops to guard the harbor's perimeter. Menethil's survival depends on sabotaging the catapults before they can be brought against the town.

Scouts carry Dwarven Tinder into the heart of the Dragonmaw encampment. They must set the timber catapults ablaze and destroy them, stripping Nek'rosh of his artillery and denying his warriors the firepower to break Menethil's defenses. The engines must be ruined before the warlord himself can be confronted.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were fighting the Dragonmaws, we discovered more of their plans.
Nek'rosh has built catapults and aims to lay siege to Menethil! And with the fighting in Dun Algaz, we're effectively blocked from reinforcements!
You need to take out those catapults. They're in the Dragonmaw encampment.
Here, take this tinder. Fight your way to the catapults and light them with the tinder.
And after you've done that, find and kill Nek'rosh. We need to cut this Dragonmaw beast down...at its neck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The first catapult is before you. Will you set it aflame?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place some of the tinder on the catapult then strike a spark onto it.
